limitations: One fixed English request/seed with the built-in voice, resident FP32 Turbo model, sampling and original CPU Perth watermark. No prompt encoding or file encoding. Not a throughput, multi-request or all-prompt study.

GX skips GPU arithmetic and replays200GPU scalar/shape/CPU-array controls perrequest. Original scalar reads and final waveform D2H copy remain; prerecorded real CPU waveform feeds the original CPU watermark. GX cannot independently validate generated audio.

Real cuFFT fails with CUFFT_INTERNAL_ERROR under this GX runtime. GX-only HiFT16point/hop4STFT/ISTFT shape adapters omit FFT, associated window/pointwise/overlap work and host dispatch. Native executes original methods; separate native guarded runs check actual shapes and control values.

Baseline native-only launches also include unsupported FP32 GEMM and cuDNN plan differences. Their isolated medians sum to15.702677ms/request, not an end-to-end correction. Exact launch audits and misses are retained; no exact native replay claim.

Initial GPU calibration comprises original model kernels plus two FP32 GELU-tanh primitive shapes. Both were obtained before any mode2 candidate evaluation. The merged predictor preserves480measured signatures; candidate generation was not benchmarked onGPU during discovery.

Fused tanhGELU uses the same mathematical approximation with different FP32 rounding. Initial primitive checks had maximum absolute error2.3841858e-7. Identical measured native audio hashes apply to this request, not a bitwise equivalence guarantee for every input.

CPU profile461unresolved out6197instruction samples(7.44%),23unresolved task samples. GX and A100 use different CPU hosts. Native primary samples omit tape and FFT hooks; absolute timings are not a matched-instrumentation accuracy study.
Mode3 uses10us epochs; CPU/GPU spans include synchronization/granularity effects and are not hardware utilization. Compact counters are unions within bins, not additive resource utilization.
Watermark oracle saved-tensor bytes count references, including parameter tensors;21.237MB is not a claim of that much additional unique allocated host memory.
